name: Pierre Louÿs
bio: French poet and novelist (1870-1925). He founded the review La Conque in 1889, at nineteen, and printed Swinburne, Verlaine, Mallarmé, Maeterlinck, Gide and Moréas in it. He met Wilde in Paris in November 1891, went over the French of Salomé line by line, and Wilde dedicated the play to him - 'À mon ami Pierre Louÿs', his name, as Wilde put it, written in gold on purple. Fifteen months later the friendship was over. Seven of Wilde's letters to him survive and they hold the whole arc, from 'Cher Monsieur Louÿs' to 'Mon très cher Ennemi' to the last one, which ends: 'It is new to me to think that friendship is more brittle than love is.'
bio_note: Seven letters; four read (printed 496, 506, 528, 557) Dates 1870-1925 from the editors' note at printed 496.
